TAKEDA DEAL (closed late 2025): US$1.2bn upfront including a US$100mn equity investment, and up to about US$10.2bn in milestones across IBI363, IBI343 and IBI3001 (option). IBI363: 60/40 Takeda/Innovent split of global development cost and of US profit/loss (Takeda leads); royalties outside the US and Greater China. IBI343: Takeda holds rights outside Greater China; Innovent receives milestones and tiered royalties. FIGURES FROM SNIPPETS: the IBI343 15亿元 quote text comes from search snippets of press summaries of the SPDBI report. The PDF's Chinese text would not extract, but its numeric line '25 IBI343 15' matches. For mazdutide, a Macquarie peak of 8.6 billion yuan in 2031 (via a secondary page dated 2026-01-15; the original thestar.com.my URL now returns 404) and CITIC's 84.5亿元 (Jul 2025) are noted only, because the product is marketed. data.notes: Rebuilt 2026-10-05 from LLY_current.json (as of 2026-09-26). Changes vs the stored entry: (1) Kisunla (donanemab), Mounjaro/Zepbound (tirzepatide) and Jaypirca (pirtobrutinib) moved from assets to approved_portfolio -- marketed products whose sales are in operating revenue; their label-expansion studies (donanemab prevention TRAILBLAZER-ALZ 3/5/6, tirzepatide adolescent/T1D/MMO/MASLD, Jaypirca CLL) are covered there. The stored Mounjaro $68.7bn BMO peak and Kisunla $5bn Jefferies peak are dropped with them. (2) Orforglipron: stored as phase_3 with launch 2026 and a '$26 billion consensus' quote that did not name the drug (Wolfe, investing.com); it is now approved (Foundayo, US obesity 2026-04-01) and carried as an approved asset with the Bloomberg consensus $18bn by 2030; T2D submitted US/EU/Japan in Q2 2026 after ACHIEVE-1/-2/-3/-5 (and ACHIEVE-4 CV safety, Q1 2026). Indication is metabolic (obesity/T2D), not CNS. (3) Retatrutide: the stored $6.6bn 'peak consensus' (older FierceBiotech article) and 0.70 PTRS quote (not a probability) replaced: GlobalData $15.6bn 2031 sales (Dec 2025); higher published figures exist (Evaluate World Preview 2026, June 2026: ~$23bn peak, read from a search snippet of FierceBiotech, not the page; Truist $12-19bn worldwide peak range, snippet only). Launch moved 2027 -> 2028: TRIUMPH-1/-2/-3 completed Jan-Jun 2026, Lilly's 2026-07-23 announcement and Q2 2026 release (2026-08-05) put the US BLA in Q1 2027 (obesity, OSA, knee OA pain). New safety signal: dysesthesia (up to 20.9% at 12 mg in TRIUMPH-4). (4) New asset: remternetug (TRAILRUNNER-ALZ 3, PC 2029-04). (5) Unapproved late-stage programmes without a usable single-asset peak are excluded with reasons (eloralintide, olomorasib, muvalaplin, lepodisiran, brenipatide, sofetabart mipitecan, vepugratinib, tersolisib, AK-OTOF, cleminorexton). Other changes in the last 6 months: Inluriyo (imlunestrant) monotherapy approved Sept 2025 and in combination with Verzenio 2026-09-18 (ESR1m advanced breast cancer); adjuvant EMBER-4 (NCT05514054, >8,000 patients) reads out 2027 -- the larger opportunity, covered as an Inluriyo label expansion (TD Securities: Inluriyo $1.05bn by 2032, all indications). Ebglyss Q8W maintenance dosing approved (Q2 2026); Jaypirca EC approval in CLL all lines and positive BRUIN CLL-322 (+venetoclax/rituximab); Retevmo adjuvant RET+ NSCLC (LIBRETTO-432) positive (83% recurrence/death risk reduction); olomorasib Breakthrough Therapy in previously treated KRAS G12C pancreatic cancer; Novartis pelacarsen (Lp(a)) failed its outcomes trial (Sept 2026), raising class risk for lepodisiran and muvalaplin.
